displayName: AI model deployments should have a content filter assigned
description: Audit Cognitive Services model deployments (Foundry, Azure OpenAI) whose raiPolicyName is missing, empty, or Microsoft.Nil. The default or any named custom content filter passes. Does not inspect the settings inside a custom filter, so a custom filter with relaxed or disabled categories is not detected. Models that do not support content filtering, such as audio models, may need an exemption. Audit is the default.

builtInReview.gap: No live GA built-in among 2862 definitions checks that a deployment has any content filter assigned. The preview content-filter built-ins (B22-B25) need filter-name and severity parameters.

metadata.description: Audit reports model deployments without a content filter. Deny is available only for a separate explicit assignment.
